description: Get ready for an evening of unapologetic laughs with Mohd. title: Bali Ka Basra by Tushar Basra - A Stand Up Solo
description: After resonating with audiences online through his takes on middle-class madness, Delhi households, and the quiet horror of growing up “just fine,” Tushar Basra is now hitting the road with his stand-up comedy solo — Bali Ka Basra. This hour-long show blends crisp storytelling, sharp punchlines, and hilarious truths about engineering college dreams, awkward first jobs, and everything in between. If you’ve ever lived in a shared flat, stood in a queue unnecessarily, or been stuck in a meeting wondering what your job really is—this show will feel oddly personal. Tushar Basra is touring with this show across India, so grab your tickets, bring your friends and family, and come be part of an evening where laughter is the only thing that’s guaranteed and affordable.
